recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man sitting on the tailgate of a white pickup truck inside a dark barn, positioned beneath a large, glowing red and cyan neon sign mounted on a wooden loft.
coreVisualRelationships: The neon sign acts as the primary light source, casting a red glow on the subject's hair and shoulders.
The subject's white tank top provides a bright central focal point against the dark barn interior.
The horizontal lines of the truck tailgate and the neon sign frame the subject vertically.
The contrast between the rustic wood textures and the electric neon creates a modern-country aesthetic.
coreInvariants: Red neon glow on the subject's upper body
Symmetrical composition with the subject centered
Dark, shadowy background within the barn structure
High-contrast lighting from the neon sign

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered in the middle ground, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red neon sign at the top of the frame serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright neon text, moves down to the subject's face and white shirt, and finally to the truck's tailgate.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the barn interior provide negative space that emphasizes the illuminated elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and black shadows provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red from the neon sign creates the primary color contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/teal neon horizontal bar provides a cool-toned break in the warm palette.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon lights against low-value, desaturated shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, cyan, white, and dark earth tones

letterConstructionRules: Double-line glass tube construction for the main text
Internal glow effect with a softer outer bloom
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' and 'D' characters feature continuous loops
The script element uses a single-line neon tube style
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric neon block letters paired with a fluid, handwritten neon script for contrast.
graphicDevices: Wooden mounting board for the sign

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the physical construction of gas-filled glass
Provides a similar geometric skeleton for neon effects

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a white tank top and ripped jeans sitting on the tailgate of a white truck inside a dark, rustic wooden barn at night. Ensure red light spills from above onto his head and shoulders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom neon sign graphic over the top third of the image. Use double-line red neon for the main text and a single-line cyan neon script for the middle connector, adding a bloom effect to simulate light emission.

verificationChecks: Does the neon light realistically interact with the subject's hair?
Is the text centered perfectly with the truck and subject?
Is the cyan bar the only cool-toned element in the upper half?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify the neon tubes have a bright white core.
Check that the red light reflects on the truck's edges.
Ensure the subject's face is clearly visible despite the shadows.
Confirm the script text is legible against the cyan bar.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical portrait + Low-light barn setting + Stacked neon signage + Red/Cyan color contrast
